What ForgeHub is

ForgeHub is a digital workspace for turning an idea into a finished, documented project. The same way GitHub tracks how code evolves, ForgeHub tracks how a build evolves — the research, the failed prototypes, the design decisions, the fixes. The journey is the product.

Who it's for

  • →Engineering students turning a year of work into a real thesis, not a scramble
  • →Project leads who need their team documenting as they go, not at the deadline
  • →Makers and researchers who want proof they can actually build something

The core loop

Make the record while the work is still fresh.

ForgeHub is opinionated about what a technical project should leave behind, without pretending every team builds the same way.

01

Guided documentation

Start with prompts for the problem, requirements, design, testing, and the decisions that connect them.

02

AI-assisted drafting

Turn your own notes into a useful first draft. Every AI output stays visibly draft until a human accepts it.

03

Roles that make sense

Give contributors editing access and advisors review access without turning permissions into guesswork.

04

A living decisions log

Capture what the team chose, what it considered, and why the choice made sense at the time.

05

Evidence beside the record

Attach sketches, research, images, and supporting files where the team will actually find them.

06

A considered public snapshot

Publish the sections you choose when the work is ready. Private project content never becomes public by accident.

01 Explore

02 Create a project

Why ForgeHub

The problem is not your work ethic. It is where the work lives.

Great technical work gets lost when the reasoning is scattered. ForgeHub gives the project one thread from problem statement to outcome.

Without ForgeHub

  • Scattered across WhatsApp, Drive, and a notebook
  • Files nobody else can open when context matters
  • No record of why a decision was made
  • An empty portfolio when it is time to apply

With ForgeHub

  • One workspace, one source of truth
  • Guided documentation for every phase
  • A decisions log nobody has to reconstruct
  • A shareable case study when you are ready

Questions

Is ForgeHub free?+

Yes — free for individuals, no card required.

Do I need a team to use it?+

No. Solo builders, research pairs, and full project teams all work the same way.

What if my project isn't finished?+

Most aren't. ForgeHub is built around projects in progress, not just finished ones — publish whenever, or never.

Can my advisor or mentor join?+

Yes — invite them with the Advisor role. They can comment and review without editing your work.

Is my project private by default?+

Yes. Nothing is visible outside your team until you explicitly publish it, section by section.

What kinds of projects work on ForgeHub?+

Hardware, software, and research projects — anything with a real build and documentation process.
